messages:
marta_ml: Quick sprint sync — posting owners/PRs for kernel + KV work. Owners: Alex for kernel fusion, Linh for KV prefetch + cache invalidation, Sam for batching infra. Please confirm ETA for the milestones below.

alex_runtime: Kernel fusion PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5129
Benchmarks on A100 (seq=1024): p50 18ms -> 12ms after fusion, p95 62ms -> 41ms. Need CI fix (flake in test_kernels.py) before merge.

sam_prs: Pinged on the PR, will review tonight. Heads up: my last perf run shows an odd latency spike with batch_size>64 — reproducer attached.

linh_eng: KV prefetch branch is at draft, plan to land prefetch + LRU eviction in two parts. ETA for part1 (prefetch warmup): Thu EOD. Part2 (eviction + metrics): next Wed.

chris_sre: FYI infra dependency: scheduler v2 rollout scheduled for Fri 03:00 UTC; if that goes wrong it could block the perf jobs. I can gate the rollout if you need more time.

alex_runtime: Noted on CI. @sam_prs can you share repro snippet? quick one-liner:
```bash
python -m tests.perf --kernel fusion --batch 128
```

sam_prs: repro posted in the PR comments, includes flamegraph and heap profile link. suspect a memory growth in continuous batching path.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: scheduler-v2 -> canary -> all (Fri 03:00 UTC). Link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/rollouts/867

marta_ml: Thanks. Owners, confirm PR reviewer + merge blockers by EOD. Also next sprint goal: ship kernel fusion + KV prefetch part1 and set up perf regression alert for p95 > 1.5x baseline. If any blocker, flag here.

alex_runtime: I'll pick up the CI flake and tag reviewers @sam_prs @linh_eng. ETA: tomorrow morning.

linh_eng: Confirmed part1 ETA Thu EOD. I will add metrics (cache hit, eviction rate) as PR comments.

sam_prs: I'll do review tonight, but if memory leak is real may need a follow-up patch. Will distro allocation impact testing? @chris_sre

chris_sre: We can spin a dedicated perf lane on the canary cluster for the next 48h. Ping me when ready and I'll reserve it.

marta_ml: Great. I'll update the sprint board and assign the handoff ticket to @alex_runtime for post-merge monitoring. Final note: please add a short runbook snippet in PR describing rollback steps if fusion increases p95.
